name: Hayek Global College - Faculdade Internacional Brasília
summary: English-taught college in Brasília: a two-year Brazilian Human Resources Management degree with an overseas bachelor's pathway.

ib.text: Secondary-school diploma and transcripts required. IB is not listed for an English or maths test waiver; another qualifying test can waive these exams. Confirm foreign-diploma recognition and the suitable 2027 intake.

notes: The Brazilian first stage awards a Human Resources Management tecnólogo; overseas bachelor's majors are later transfer choices, not separate first-year Hayek degrees.
The guide links a 2027 first-semester call; a May 2027 IB candidate needs a later start, whose availability and dates require confirmation.
Published tuition is R$5,900 a month, or R$70,800 a year, without an intake year; confirm the 2027 contract and additional overseas costs.

programmes.name: Human Resources Management (Hayek American College)
programmes.about: An English-taught Brazilian Human Resources Management degree in Brasília, with an American-style core and a route to later bachelor's study overseas.
programmes.overview: The first two years combine an American-style core with a Brazilian higher-education qualification in Human Resources Management. Students explore business and other subjects in English before choosing a later specialism. The college describes project work and international collaboration within this first stage. Students can then seek transfer to a partner institution for a separate bachelor's degree; available majors, credit recognition and remaining study time depend on the destination.
programmes.ib: English and maths exams normally require 70% to pass. The guide marks IB credits as NA for test waivers; ask how the Diploma is assessed for entry.
programmes.selectionNote: English/maths screening, then transcripts 20%, portfolio 30%, video pitch 20% and simulated class 30%; qualifying external scores can waive the screening exams.
